## Checklist

- [ ] One proposal per pull request (or a cross-cutting typo fix).
- [ ] Every new claim is labelled `[OFFICIAL]`, `[DERIVED]`, `[ASSUMPTION]`, or `[OPEN]`.
- [ ] Formula, worked example, and test vector agree.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes.
- [ ] `npm run check:spec` passes.
- [ ] No personal data, keys, seed phrases, or wallet addresses.
- [ ] No price prediction or return promise.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for a substantive change.
